collaboration.title: Collaboration administration
collaboration.description: Complete, cancel, or reopen collaborations whose creator is disabled.
collaboration.accessRequired: A current super administrator account is required to manage these collaborations.
collaboration.creator: Original creator
collaboration.metadataUnavailable: Current task details are unavailable. Original requests can still be checked below.
collaboration.creatorRestored: The creator's account is enabled again. New administration changes are unavailable; you can still check an earlier request.
collaboration.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for this change.
collaboration.reasonInvalid: The reason is too long or contains unsupported characters. Edit it and try again.
collaboration.successorHint: Both the creator and handler are disabled. Choose an eligible participant to handle the reopened task.
collaboration.successorRequired: Choose a participant to handle the reopened task.
collaboration.successorExpired: The selected participant is no longer available. Refresh and choose again.
collaboration.candidatesUnavailable: Eligible participants are unavailable. Refresh before choosing a handler.
collaboration.snapshotChanged: The task or available actions changed. Close this confirmation, refresh, and review the latest details.
collaboration.lifecycleNotice: Completing or cancelling does not confirm that AI processes have stopped. Reopening keeps execution paused.
collaboration.pendingHint: The outcome is not confirmed. This original request is preserved for recovery.
collaboration.notRecorded: No result is recorded yet. The original request is preserved.
collaboration.receiptHint: This receipt describes the original change. Refresh task details to see the current state.
collaboration.rejected: This change was refused. Refresh task details and start a new confirmation.
collaboration.invalid: Choose an available status and, when required, an eligible participant.
collaboration.failed: The result could not be confirmed. Check the original request.

collaboration.title: 协作任务代管
collaboration.description: 为创建人已停用的协作任务办理完成、取消或重开。
collaboration.accessRequired: 仅当前有效的超级管理员可代管这些协作任务。
collaboration.empty: 暂无需要代管的协作任务。
collaboration.creator: 原创建人
collaboration.metadataUnavailable: 暂时无法读取当前任务详情，仍可在下方查询原请求结果。
collaboration.creatorRestored: 创建人账号已重新启用，无法再发起代管变更，仍可查询此前的请求结果。
collaboration.reasonInvalid: 原因过长或包含不支持的字符，请修改后重试。
collaboration.successorHint: 创建人和经办人均已停用，请选择一位符合条件的参与者接手重开的任务。
collaboration.successorEmpty: 暂无符合条件的参与者。
collaboration.successorRequired: 请选择参与者接手重开的任务。
collaboration.successorExpired: 所选参与者已不可用，请刷新后重新选择。
collaboration.candidatesUnavailable: 暂时无法读取可选参与者，请刷新后再选择经办人。
collaboration.snapshotChanged: 任务或可用操作已变更，请关闭本次确认、刷新并核对最新详情。
collaboration.lifecycleNotice: 完成或取消任务不代表 AI 进程已确认停止。重开后执行仍保持暂停。
collaboration.pendingHint: 结果尚未确认，已保留本次原始请求供后续查询。
collaboration.notRecorded: 暂未查到结果，原始请求已保留。
collaboration.receiptHint: 此回执记录原始变更，当前状态请以刷新后的任务详情为准。

outcomes.reopened: 任务已重开，执行保持暂停

collaboration.rejected: 本次变更已被拒绝，请刷新任务详情后重新确认。
collaboration.invalid: 请选择可用状态，并在需要时选择符合条件的参与者。
collaboration.failed: 暂时无法确认结果，请查询原请求。
